definitions.explanation: A building with many stories, typically used for offices, apartments, or hotels. Generally refers to buildings over ten stories tall.

examples.japanese: {高層|こうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: High-rise buildings stand in a row.

examples.japanese: {高層|こうそう}ビル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最上階|さいじょうかい}→最上階：30428_saijoukai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
examples.english: The view from the top floor of the skyscraper is wonderful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高層|こうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦オフィス→オフィス：00327_ofisu⟧{街|がい}になっている。
examples.english: Shinjuku has many skyscrapers and has become one of Tokyo's representative office districts.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧ is an abbreviation of ビルディング (building). ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ means "high-rise" or "multi-storied." The compound ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル→超高層ビル：21449_choukousoubiru⟧ refers to supertall buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高層|こうそう}ビル⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧ (cluster of skyscrapers)
- {高層|こうそう}ビル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧ (rooftop of a high-rise)
- {高層|こうそう}ビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧ (a high-rise is built)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}ビル→超高層ビル：21449_choukousoubiru⟧: supertall building — even taller than a {高層|こうそう}ビル, typically over 60 meters
